criteria.description: @spec-kitty/elements and @spec-kitty/react are publishable and appear in the derived set

criteria.description: release.yml's build, publish and audit steps consume one derived list

criteria.description: The release path is exercised on every pull request
criteria.evidence: New unconditional `release-gate` job in ci-quality.yml, in `gate`'s strict list with no skipped-tolerance entry, and required by check-gate-wiring.mjs's REQUIRED_RELEASE payload table. The 16 disarm results quoted earlier were a HAND exercise by a review lens, not a shipped harness — check-gate-wiring.mjs has no probe table of its own. criteria.evidence: All 15 of packages/styles/src's component directories now have subpath exports, up from 3. `checkSubpathCoverage` compares export keys against directories on disk, because checkExportsResolve catches a broken export but not a missing one; removing any single entry reds the gate.

criteria.evidence: `checkGraphFailsClosed` builds real fixture package trees (all-private, empty, no build target) and asserts the REAL accessors throw. Deleting both throws in release-graph.mjs reds the gate — verified. The earlier version passed synthetic stubs and could not fire.

criteria.description: A file:// load issues zero off-machine requests, asserted by interception
criteria.evidence: check-offline-load.mjs stages from real `npm pack` tarballs in a node_modules layout, intercepts requests AND websockets, waits 2s past load, and asserts 14/14 elements upgraded. The 30 @font-face sources are resolved against the packed tarball on DISK in stage(); the browser-side assertion is that at least one @font-face rule registered. Stated separately because an earlier version of this row implied both were browser assertions.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: ADR-5's release controls apply to every package in the derived set
criteria.evidence: provenance and the contents audit loop the derived set; check-release-graph.mjs asserts tarball contents on the release path. NOT looped, stated precisely because an earlier version of this row overstated it: npm-audit-gate.sh runs one workspace-wide `npm audit --audit-level=high`, and CycloneDX runs once at the repo root. Both are whole-workspace controls by design, which covers the derived set without iterating it.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: File count and unpacked size per package are recorded; packed size is reported but not committed
criteria.evidence: SIZES.md 'Published package sizes'. Packed size was committed first and CI reddened on it immediately: 3812.1 KiB (workstation) vs 3827.7 KiB (CI) for identical @spec-kitty/tokens contents, while files and unpacked matched exactly. Packed is the gzipped tarball, so it varies with the running machine's zlib; committing it reds builds on untouched trees.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: WITHDRAWN — mono font resolution is a brand decision (fork 2 on #80)
criteria.evidence: The dead @import is deleted (mechanical, no behaviour change: 32 rules / 0 imports before and after). The token still names a family that does not load; self-hosting vs dropping it is the operator's.
criteria.notes: WITHDRAWN from spec.md's tables, so this row records the withdrawal rather than a pass. Marked fail rather than n/a: the verdict enum has no not-applicable value, and recording a withdrawn requirement as passing would be false.

criteria.description: Every committed size figure is a deterministic function of the built artifacts
criteria.evidence: packed tarball size varies with zlib on IDENTICAL inputs (3812.1 vs 3827.7 KiB) and is excluded from the record; files/unpacked/raw/minified vary only when the artifact itself differs. Note SIZES.md states its own basis: esbuild embeds module paths, so a checkout whose node_modules resolves differently changes the byte count and the SRI hash — the committed figures are CI's, which is a property of the build, not of the record.
criteria.notes: Added after CI reddened on the first committed revision of this table.

negative_invariants: A release must never report success having published nothing: release-graph.mjs's output is captured into shell variables and asserted non-empty, because `echo "x=$(failing-cmd)"` exits 0 and `for pkg in ; do` iterates zero times.
A gate must never read an exit code where npm returns 0 for a no-op: `npm publish` on a private package warns and exits 0.
An exports wildcard matching zero files is a failure, not a pass.
A tarball containing only package.json/README/LICENSE ships nothing usable, even though npm always includes them.
A hand-written package list in any workflow is a second source of truth and is rejected.
The offline probe must red on a planted off-machine request, or its green means nothing.
